Fellow Methusalehs:

Whilst awaiting my box of Bloodlines, I have been reading about a
number of these cards, and there seem to be a number of *dual*
discipline cards, such as "The Call" and "Nightmare Curse". In order
to use the superior version of these cards, does a vampire have to
have BOTH disciplines (e.g. Auspex AND Dementation for "The Call") at
superior??

Yikes! That seems to be quite a narrow user population. And while
they are somewhat powerful, any Meth would have to go thru some
gyrations!

Any insight?
Madman
